_meta.description: Saudi/GCC integration playbooks. Each playbook gives the AI engineer everything needed to add a critical Saudi-market integration to a customer's app: setup steps, code templates (Flutter/RN/Web), security gotchas, testing harness, common bugs. Loaded by handle_get_integration_playbook tool.

nafath.where_to_get: https://nafath.sa/business — request approved partner status from NIC. Takes ~10 business days.
setup_steps_ar: 1) سجّل في nafath.sa/business (يتطلب CR + ترخيص نظامي مثل CMA/SAMA)
2) بعد الموافقة، تحصل على Client ID + Client Secret + RSA keypair
3) ضع callback URL في dashboard نفاذ (مثلاً https://yourapp.com/auth/nafath/callback)
4) في تطبيقك، اضف زر «تسجيل عبر نفاذ»
5) أرسل المستخدم لـ /api/v1/api/Authorize مع MFA flow
6) Nafath يرسل push notification لجوال المستخدم → يضغط الرقم المطابق → تستقبل callback
security_gotchas: NEVER store the random number — it's shown to the user, then thrown away
Polling timeout must be 60s max — Nafath transactions expire at 60s
Always store NAFATH_CLIENT_SECRET in secure storage (Keychain/Keystore), NEVER in AsyncStorage
Use certificate pinning for nafath.sa requests
On callback, verify the transId belongs to the current session (XSRF protection)
common_bugs: Forgetting the APP-ID and APP-KEY headers (returns 401)
Not handling the 'expired' state from poll (user sees infinite spinner)
Using nationalId without prepending country code in some API versions
Not extracting transId from response HEADER (it's not in the body)
nafath.testing_harness: Use Nafath sandbox: https://nafath.sa/business/sandbox — supplies test nationalId 1000000001 with mock OTP.

mada_payment.where_to_get: Via a gateway aggregator: HyperPay, PayTabs, Tap, Moyasar, Geidea — sign up at any one, NEVER deal with banks directly
setup_steps_ar: 1) اختر gateway: للسعودية الأشهر Moyasar (أسعار منافسة) أو HyperPay
2) سجّل تجارياً → يطلبون CR + IBAN + هوية المدير
3) موافقة المفعّل 3-5 أيام عمل
4) احصل على Live API Key + Webhook Secret
5) في تطبيقك أضف SDK المناسب (Moyasar Flutter, PayTabs RN)
6) لا تخزّن أرقام البطاقات أبداً — استخدم tokenization
7) فعّل 3D Secure (3DS) للحماية الإضافية

code_templates.webhook_handler_python:
# Backend webhook to confirm payment (source of truth)
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, HTTPException
import hmac, hashlib, os
router = APIRouter()

@router.post('/api/webhooks/moyasar')
async def moyasar_webhook(request: Request):
    secret = os.environ['MOYASAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET'].encode()
    payload = await request.body()
    signature = request.headers.get('moyasar-signature', '')
    expected = hmac.new(secret, payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected):
        raise HTTPException(401, 'invalid signature')
    event = await request.json()
    if event['type'] == 'payment_paid':
        order_id = event['data']['metadata']['order_id']
        # ATOMIC: mark order paid in DB. Idempotent because Stripe may retry.
        await db.orders.update_one({'id': order_id}, {'$set': {'status': 'paid'}})
    return {'ok': True}

security_gotchas: ZATCA requires fatura electronic invoice within 24 hours of payment
Never log card numbers, even partial. Mask to ****1234
3DS must be enabled — without it, chargebacks are not refundable to you
Webhook is source of truth, NOT the redirect URL (user may close browser)
common_bugs: Trusting the success redirect → customer pays but order not marked paid
Amount in wrong unit (Moyasar uses halalas = SAR × 100, NOT SAR)
Not handling 'authorized but not captured' state for COD-style flows
Webhook idempotency missing → double-credit when Stripe retries

tabby_bnpl.where_to_get: https://tabby.ai/business — apply with CR; takes 5-7 business days
setup_steps_ar: 1) سجّل في tabby.ai/business
2) موافقة قسم Risk → احصل على المفاتيح
3) أضف Tabby SDK في checkout
4) عند نجاح الـ pre-scoring تظهر خيارات التقسيط (4 دفعات)
5) Webhook عند الموافقة النهائية → علّم الطلب paid
security_gotchas: Tabby pre-screening can REJECT — handle gracefully, don't crash UI
Webhook MUST use HMAC validation (Tabby-Signature header)
Don't expose secret key in client; only public key in mobile/web SDK
common_bugs: Sending phone without +966 prefix → 400 error
Buyer history dates not ISO 8601 → silent rejection
Not handling 'CANCELED' state when user backs out

simah_credit_bureau.where_to_get: https://simah.com — only licensed finance companies (SAMA approved). Requires SAMA finance license.
setup_steps_ar: 1) لازم تكون شركة تمويل مرخّصة من SAMA
2) سجّل في SIMAH كـ Inquirer
3) احصل على API token + Inquirer Number
4) كل استعلام يكلّف ~3-5 ريال (يُخصم من رصيدك في SIMAH)
5) لا تستعلم بدون موافقة العميل صراحة (إلزامي قانوناً)

code_templates.consumer_inquiry_python:
# Backend SIMAH consumer credit inquiry
import httpx
from datetime import datetime

async def get_credit_report(national_id: str, consent_id: str):
    '''Returns SIMAH credit score + active obligations.
    consent_id MUST be obtained from the customer (e.g. via Nafath or signed agreement).'''
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        r = await client.post(
            'https://api.simah.com/v1/CCR/Individual',
            json={
                'NationalId': national_id,
                'ConsentId': consent_id,
                'InquiryReason': 'PRODUCT_DECISION',
                'InquirerNumber': os.environ['SIMAH_INQUIRER_NUMBER'],
            },
            headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.environ["SIMAH_API_TOKEN"]}'},
        )
        if r.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f'SIMAH error: {r.text}')
        data = r.json()
        return {
            'score': data['Score'],  # 300-900
            'risk_grade': data['RiskGrade'],  # A/B/C/D/E
            'active_obligations': data.get('ActiveObligations', []),
            'total_monthly_payment': sum(o['MonthlyPayment'] for o in data.get('ActiveObligations', [])),
        }

def calculate_dti(monthly_income: float, monthly_obligations: float):
    '''SAMA mandates DTI <= 65%. Returns approve/reject + DTI ratio.'''
    if monthly_income <= 0: return ('reject', 1.0)
    dti = monthly_obligations / monthly_income
    return ('approve' if dti <= 0.65 else 'reject', round(dti, 3))

security_gotchas: Consent ID is REQUIRED by SAMA — never inquire without explicit customer consent
Store the consent proof (Nafath signature or signed PDF) for 7 years (regulatory)
PII (national IDs, scores) must be encrypted at rest (AES-256 + key rotation)
Audit log every inquiry — SAMA may audit
Don't cache SIMAH responses beyond 24 hours — outdated data = bad decisions
common_bugs: Forgetting DTI 65% rule → over-lending → regulatory penalty
Misreading risk grade (A is best, E is worst — easy to invert)
Not handling 'no_record_found' (new customers with no history)
Treating monthly_payment as annual or vice versa

zatca_einvoice.where_to_get: https://fatoora.zatca.gov.sa — onboard via the Fatoora portal. Free.
setup_steps_ar: 1) سجّل في fatoora.zatca.gov.sa بحساب الجهاز
2) أكمل onboarding للحصول على Cryptographic Stamp Identifier
3) ولّد CSR + private key محلياً (لا ترفع الـ private key أبداً)
4) كل فاتورة لازم تشمل: BUYER name + national ID/VAT + invoice hash + QR code + previous invoice hash (chain)
5) أرسل XML invoice لـ ZATCA API → reporting (simplified) أو clearance (standard)
6) ZATCA يرجع UUID + clearance status — احفظ في DB

code_templates.zatca_invoice_xml_python:
# Generate ZATCA-compliant UBL 2.1 invoice XML
import hashlib, base64, qrcode, io
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from lxml import etree

def build_invoice_xml(invoice_number, seller, buyer, items, vat_rate=0.15, previous_hash=''):
    subtotal = sum(i['quantity'] * i['unit_price'] for i in items)
    vat = subtotal * vat_rate
    total = subtotal + vat
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
    # Build UBL XML — abbreviated, full version is ~80 fields
    root = etree.Element('Invoice', nsmap={None: 'urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:Invoice-2'})
    etree.SubElement(root, 'cbc:ID').text = invoice_number
    etree.SubElement(root, 'cbc:IssueDate').text = now[:10]
    etree.SubElement(root, 'cbc:InvoiceTypeCode').text = '388'  # Tax invoice
    # ... seller, buyer, items, totals ...
    invoice_bytes = etree.tostring(root, pretty_print=True)
    invoice_hash = base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(invoice_bytes).digest()).decode()
    # ZATCA QR code (TLV-encoded)
    qr = generate_zatca_qr(seller['name'], seller['vat_number'], now, total, vat, invoice_hash)
    return {'xml': invoice_bytes, 'hash': invoice_hash, 'qr': qr}

def generate_zatca_qr(seller_name, vat, dt, total, vat_amount, inv_hash):
    '''TLV format (Tag, Length, Value) — ZATCA Phase 2 mandatory.'''
    def tlv(tag, value):
        v = value.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(value, str) else value
        return bytes([tag, len(v)]) + v
    payload = (tlv(1, seller_name) + tlv(2, vat) + tlv(3, dt) +
               tlv(4, f'{total:.2f}') + tlv(5, f'{vat_amount:.2f}') +
               tlv(6, inv_hash))
    return base64.b64encode(payload).decode()

security_gotchas: Private key NEVER leaves the server — sign locally, send signed result
Hash CHAIN is critical: previous_hash → current_hash → next invoice. Break the chain and you must re-onboard.
QR code MUST be on the printed/displayed invoice — not just the XML
common_bugs: Wrong InvoiceTypeCode (388 = tax invoice, 381 = credit note — easy to confuse)
Missing buyer VAT number for B2B invoices (B2C uses CR or doesn't require)
VAT rate hardcoded → wrong for exempt items (medical, education)
Forgetting the QR code on simplified invoices

stc_pay.where_to_get: Via your payment gateway (Moyasar, HyperPay, PayTabs) — STC Pay is offered as a method, not directly
setup_steps_ar: 1) STC Pay is a payment method inside your gateway — no separate merchant account
2) Enable STC Pay in your Moyasar/HyperPay dashboard
3) The flow: user enters phone → receives OTP → confirms payment
4) Settlement is T+1 to your IBAN
common_bugs: Forgetting to add 'stcpay' to methods array (only credit card showed)
Phone format issues — must be +966XXXXXXXXX

whatsapp_business.where_to_get: https://business.facebook.com → WhatsApp Business → Cloud API. Requires verified business + approved phone number.
setup_steps_ar: 1) Verify your business at business.facebook.com (CR + utility bill)
2) Add WhatsApp product → Get a phone number (or use your existing)
3) Verify the phone via OTP
4) Submit message templates for approval (each template takes 24-48h to approve)
5) Test with the sandbox first using +447... test numbers
6) Move to production after first template approval

code_templates.send_template_message_python:
# Send approved template message via WhatsApp Cloud API
import httpx, os

async def send_whatsapp_template(to_phone: str, template_name: str, params: list):
    '''to_phone must be E.164 format with country code (e.g. +966555555555).
    template_name must be pre-approved in Facebook Business Manager.'''
    url = f'https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/{os.environ["WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID"]}/messages'
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        r = await client.post(
            url,
            headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.environ["WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN"]}'},
            json={
                'messaging_product': 'whatsapp',
                'to': to_phone.lstrip('+'),  # No leading + in body
                'type': 'template',
                'template': {
                    'name': template_name,
                    'language': {'code': 'ar'},
                    'components': [{'type': 'body', 'parameters': [{'type': 'text', 'text': p} for p in params]}],
                },
            },
        )
        return r.json()

# Example: notify customer that their order is on the way
await send_whatsapp_template('+966555123456', 'order_shipped', ['12345', 'سامسا', 'SA9999999'])

common_bugs: Sending free-form text outside the 24-hour conversation window (only templates work outside it)
Template parameters in wrong language (template approved in Arabic but you send English values)
Forgetting + → leading +966 in 'to' field breaks delivery
